about: Fixed inputs for `run.py skill`. Each word must be absent from fixtures/collection.json except the `duplicate` ones. headword = the exact <b> text expected (stress from DEX, checked 2026-10-30); plain = acceptable headwords with markup removed, when the exact form may vary.

cases.tests: irregular 3rd-conjugation verb, stress on both parts
masculine noun; stress is NOT on the last syllable
impersonal reflexive: 3sg instead of 1sg; no clitic-friendly object
fixed expression: register question to the reviewer
already on a card: must be skipped, not carded
